avb.b: On clips whose sound and picture are in sync, this tool's most likely offset is usually smaller than {T} s in magnitude; a reading counts as outside that normal range only when its offset magnitude is at least {T} s and its probability is at least {P}.
avb.c_rule: A reading inside that normal range is not grounds to revise stage 1.

v.b: Captions describe what the captioner noticed and omit many objects and actions, so an event not being mentioned in the caption is not evidence that it is absent.
v.c_rule: A missing mention alone is not grounds to revise stage 1.
